description: Work Queue lane route metadata for receipts and ledgers. Codex is the default workbench (model and effort come from codex_selection below); Claude Code is the alternate. Authority comes only from rules/runtime_permission_policy.md.

fallback.policy: An unassigned or unknown owner runs on the default workbench (Codex).

revenue.policy: The revenue lane is a work-order shape and card; it runs on the default workbench (Codex).

marketing.policy: The marketing lane is a work-order shape and card; it runs on the default workbench (Codex).

delivery.policy: The delivery lane is a work-order shape and card; it runs on the default workbench (Codex).

operations.policy: The operations lane is a work-order shape and card; it runs on the default workbench (Codex).

ops.policy: The ops lane is a work-order shape and card; it runs on the default workbench (Codex).

codex.policy: Codex remains an implementation workbench. Each step launches a fresh ephemeral session with its own 500K fuse on the tier's model and effort.

codex_selection.catalog_check: codex-cli 0.167.0 `codex debug models` on 2026-11-14 lists gpt-6-luna, gpt-6-sol and gpt-6.1-terra with low/medium/high effort. gpt-6.1-terra is listed for pinned ModelPort agent calls only; the tiers below are unchanged.

simple.use_for: read-only checks, small edits, short briefs

medium.use_for: ordinary scoped implementation; the previous fixed default

complex.use_for: risky, cross-cutting, security/ledger/schema work or retries

codex_accounts.note: Two independently paid ChatGPT subscription accounts, each signed in only in its own Codex home. Sticky: the active account (queue/codex_accounts/active.json) is kept while its five-hour window has more than switch_remaining_percent remaining, no window is exhausted and no provider restriction is set; otherwise the other account becomes active if it qualifies (A -> B -> A). Weekly has no reserve: it blocks only at exhaustion or restriction. Neither -> refuse (quota_unavailable/needs_authentication). Chosen once per new session or job by tools/aos_codex_policy.select_codex_account; never an API key.

claude.policy: Claude Code remains an implementation workbench. This metadata is stamped for receipts and ledgers only.
